description: This file defines a static class 'SiloRuntimeMetricsListener' that manages metrics collection and event handling for Orleans silo runtime, including tracking connected clients and message sizes.

classes.name: SiloRuntimeMetricsListener
classes.description: A static class that listens to runtime metrics in Orleans silo, enabling measurement event handling and tracking client and message metrics.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the MeterListener to begin listening for metrics.

methods.name: OnMeasurementRecorded
methods.description: Callback invoked when a measurement is recorded; updates internal counters for connected clients and message sizes.
